ops.text: gemini CLI (gemini-4-argon) stopped reading its API key from the macOS keychain mid-session at about 11:20 PM Nov 1: every non-interactive call exits 41 with 'must specify GEMINI_API_KEY', while the keychain item gemini-cli-api-key still holds a valid token (passing its token.accessToken as GEMINI_API_KEY works). Long-form copy lanes routed to gemini fail silently unless they check the exit code. Fix: a gemini wrapper on PATH that exports the key from the keychain item when the env lacks it.
